reviews.review_msg: An absolute dream of a professor. Lectures are engaging, Dr. King explains things super clearly and makes sure that everyone understands the content. She is encouraging during discussions and is open to hearing student perspectives and is super patient. She is a fair grader and is always willing to help in office hours. One of the best profs ever.

Bruno is one of the most helpful profs I have ever met. He is super passionate and knowledgable about the material. Yes, the topics can be a little complicated but he breaks them down super well and makes it really accessible. 10/10 would take again!

Amazing prof! Explains really clearly and gives super super helpful feedback on assignments. Grading and workload were reasonable, and bruno is really understanding, flexible, and caring. made the content really interesting!

I have had Zara for a few classes and upfront, beyond grades. She is one of the best profs of philosophy at sfu. She is willing to go above and beyond to help students. The recent course i took was extremely dense material wise for a shortened semester. If your planning to take shortened summer courses office hours are necessary to do well.

I think Zara is a really good prof but I didn't think the course was best structured for a phil of mind topic. The content is extremely dense, and although she's extremely caring, I found many of the lectures convoluted, and not overly helpful for the weekly essays. She is also surprisingly a very harsh marker, so make sure to bring your A-game!
